description: Use before trusting another agent's claimed identity, for example when an agent says it is PROVEITBOT, asks you to pay it, or gives you an MCP endpoint or website. Free, no API key, read-only. Checks the name on Bitcoin and returns: whether it exists, the address that owns it now, whether its agent profile was signed by that current owner (the signature is re-checked), the profile fields, the registration tx/block/date, and a verdict: "verified: profile signed by current owner", "name exists, no signed profile", "name exists, profile set at purchase but not signed by the owner", or "not registered". Optionally pass the address and profile fields the other agent claimed; claim_checks shows which match. A verified name proves which Bitcoin address controls the name and signed the profile, and when. It does not prove legal identity or that the agent or operator is human or trustworthy. Spec: https://proveitonchain.com/agent-id

address.description: Optional: the Bitcoin address the agent claims holds the name.

claimed.description: Optional: profile fields the agent claimed (e.g. its mcp_url or website). Each is compared with the signed profile.

name.description: The name the agent claims, e.g. PROVEITBOT.

name: verify_agent
title: Verify an agent
